summary: Vedic astrology web app with dynamic lunar climate descriptions that change based on current Moon nakshatra transit
architectural_notes: Lunar Climate Today displays nakshatra-specific content based on current Moon transit position
Each of 27 Nakshatras has unique atmospheric description and karmic lesson

existing_features.title: Update CurrentNakshatraBanner component to display the lunar climate description and karmic lesson for the currently transiting Nakshatra in the expandable pada details section, replacing or augmenting the current interpretive description
Update the admin edit page to allow editing of the new lunarClimate and karmicLesson fields for each Nakshatra

new_feature_requests.summary: Update Lunar Climate Today content for all 27 Nakshatras with atmospheric descriptions and karmic lessons
